profile.name: Tumesh
profile.tagline: Software Engineer • 3D Printing & CAD Maker • Embedded Systems
profile.bio: Building high-performance web applications, parametric 3D print generators, and embedded IoT systems.

phone-wall-clock-enclosure-generator.title: Phone Wall Clock Enclosure Generator
phone-wall-clock-enclosure-generator.description: Parametric OpenSCAD enclosure generator that upcycles old Android smartphones into wall-mounted digital clocks with hidden wire routing and snap-fit bezel clips.

BankersToolkit.title: Banker's Toolkit Android & Linux Suite
BankersToolkit.description: Comprehensive banking operations utility suite with financial calculators, account check-digit validation, recovery tracking, and legal notice tools. Available as direct Android APK and Debian desktop package.

Open-Mic.title: Open-Mic Wireless Audio Bridge
Open-Mic.description: Ultra-low-latency wireless microphone audio bridge streaming sound over local WiFi network with Android companion app and Debian desktop package.

Pdf-Redactor.title: PDF Redactor Studio
Pdf-Redactor.description: Client-side PDF redaction studio with stream-level watermark cleaner. Permanently removes employee ID watermarks, scrubs metadata, and provides 1-click banking presets. Available as Web App and Android APK.

toothbrush-clinic.title: Toothbrush Clinic & Companion App
toothbrush-clinic.description: Hygienic wall-mounted modular organizer for electric toothbrush handles and replacement heads, paired with an Android brushing companion app.

IdCardPrinterAndroid.title: ID Card Printer Android Companion
IdCardPrinterAndroid.description: Lightweight Android companion application for mobile camera capture, alignment cropping, and direct wireless card printing.

IdCardPrinter.title: ID Card Batch Photo & Alignment Tool
IdCardPrinter.description: Desktop utility for batch cropping, color balancing, and alignment grid printing of corporate ID cards. Standalone Linux binary available.

Longbook-Merger.title: LongBook Merger Studio
Longbook-Merger.description: 100% client-side A4 landscape PDF generator for CBSL & Finacle banking reports. Features Courier font scaling, multi-page Table of Contents, native ZIP archive extraction, and Linux standalone app.

Shaving-Bowl.title: Parametric Shaving Lathering Bowl
Shaving-Bowl.description: Ergonomic 3D-printable shaving lathering bowl designed in OpenSCAD with textured interior micro-ridges for rapid, dense lather generation.

boAt-PB331-Galaxy-S25-Dock.title: boAt PB331 Powerbank & Galaxy S25 Dock
boAt-PB331-Galaxy-S25-Dock.description: Precision-engineered parametric 3D printable charging dock accommodating the boAt PB331 battery pack with Samsung Galaxy S25 alignment.

guava-home.title: GuavaHome — ESP32 Smart IoT Hub
guava-home.description: An ESP32-based Smart Home controller with embedded web dashboard, sensor telemetry, Home Assistant MQTT integration, and multi-channel relay controls.

arduino-multifunction-shield-case.title: Arduino Multi-Function Shield Simulator & Case
arduino-multifunction-shield-case.description: Interactive browser hardware simulator for the HW-262 shield with 24 modes, educational games (Simon Says, Reaction Timer, Chess Clock), Web Audio synthesis, and parametric 3D case.

moon-lamp-designer.title: Moon Lamp 3D Lithophane Designer
moon-lamp-designer.description: Interactive 3D tool generating printable lithophane spherical globes and custom night-light lamp enclosures.

metric-fastener-workbench.title: Metric Fastener Sizing Workbench
metric-fastener-workbench.description: Parametric 3D printable test gauge and sizing workbench for M3, M4, and M5 screws, nuts, and heat-set threaded inserts.

3d-desk-name-plate.title: 3D Desk Nameplate Generator
3d-desk-name-plate.description: Parametric dual-color desktop nameplate generator with customizable typography, logos, and adjustable display stand angles.

piggy-bank-customizer.title: Customizable Piggy Bank
piggy-bank-customizer.description: Parametric 3D printable coin bank featuring a bayonet twist-lock bottom cap and embossed custom name personalization.

safety-razor-holder-customizer.title: Safety Razor & Blade Stand
safety-razor-holder-customizer.description: Customizable hygienic bathroom caddy and drying stand for traditional double-edge safety razors with blade pack slot.

parametric-name-keyring.title: Parametric Name Keyring
parametric-name-keyring.description: Fast-printing personalized keychain with reinforced split-ring eyelet and chamfered dual-color lettering.

cufflinks-customizer.title: Monogrammed Cufflinks Customizer
cufflinks-customizer.description: Parametric 3D printable formal cufflinks featuring custom monogram lettering and smooth toggle posts.

plate-forge.title: Plate Forge — Custom Plaque Designer
plate-forge.description: In-browser CAD generator for creating embossed and debossed equipment tags, warning plates, and serial badges.
